chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinanī, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'How should the camel be slaughtered?' He said, 'It is slaughtered while it is standing, from the right side.'

key_terms.الْبَدَنَةَ: the camel (specifically a mature one used for sacrifice or slaughter)
key_terms.يَنْحَرُ: to slaughter (specifically for large animals like camels)

ai.seo_question: How is a camel ritually slaughtered according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies the physical posture and orientation for the ritual slaughter of a camel, emphasizing that it should be done while standing and approached from the right side. This ruling highlights the distinct fiqh of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding large livestock, distinguishing it from other methods where the animal might be laid down, and underscores the importance of following the specific Sunnah of the Imams in ritual purity and practice.
